lines: Hey, I'm Daniel, a dev by passion from near Frankfurt am Main, a hosting nerd and AI tinkerer, and currently in my second year of training as an IT specialist for system integration.
I live for technology, IT infrastructure and artificial intelligence, and learning by doing is my thing because I'd rather build servers than slide decks.
+That AI tinkering includes ai-chat-webui, a privacy-focused chat UI for local Ollama models: https://github.com/drosemann/ai-chat-webui
I've been active in the Minecraft and hosting community for years, and since 22 April 2018 I've been running my Minecraft server ShadowUnity.
For my own projects I use my private stack, while at work I use the stack required there.
My full stack work covers HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Java, PHP, Python and React and TUI development.
